mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 88 degrees outside with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, under a third quarter moon.

The City of Verona has officially unveiled the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park. This art piece was created by local artists using a reclaimed ash tree and honors the movements of Tai Chi. Additionally, the city has released various information regarding upcoming election notices and sample ballots for the November 3 general election.

There is plenty to do today including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, Hop Haus Trivia is happening tomorrow, and you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company this Thursday.

In a noteworthy incident on August 30, officers responded to the 800 block of North Edge Trail after a 21-year-old man was observed smashing a vehicle window; an arrest warrant was subsequently issued for the suspect.
The Culver's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake and the restaurant is currently open for business until 10 PM, so make sure to stop by and grab a treat before they close.
